# Icon book exists under refs/ or /home/resources/icon-master (re-checked 2026-09-04: only man pages,
# icont.txt/icon.txt -- CLI driver docs, not language semantics -- and the IPL source tree; no book text).
# REFERENCE below is therefore uniformly "oracle-observed" (icont/iconx v9.5.25a behavior + this session's/
# prior sessions' cross-checked Icon-language knowledge), never a fabricated page/section number. If a real
# vendored copy turns up, upgrade REFERENCE citations then, not before.
# SCHEMA is hq_T's shared eight-column one (row ladder-forms-column-and-forms-check-every-declared-form-and-
# pair-has-a-witness): RUNG CONSTRUCT REFERENCE FORMS PAIRS WITNESS_ORIGIN STATUS NOTE. FORMS is |-separated,
# one entry per form/variation the construct exhibits (operator spelling, argument shape, boundary/failure
# case); PAIRS is |-separated lower-rung CONSTRUCT slugs for the combinations phase (sibling row
# icon-ladder-feature-combinations-after-isolation). Expected witness origins: isolation
# ladder__<rung>_<construct-prefix>_<form> (the prefix already live in ALL.csv, kept verbatim below) ·
# combinations ladder__<rung>_<construct>_with_<lower> (not yet minted -- sibling row's scope).
# ⭐ FORMS were derived MECHANICALLY from the real, oracle-graded witness population in
# corpus/tests/icon/ALL.csv (197 ladder__* origins, 2026-09-04), not hand-typed or guessed: each origin's
# trailing segment after its construct's declared prefix IS the form name, so every FORMS entry below
# names a witness that already exists and already passes (test_icon_ladder.sh --to 37: 394/394, this
# session, tree SCRIP 13ad1bcc corpus 39c4871eb -- see LEDGER). A MIXED rung (one RUNG number, several
# unrelated constructs, organic growth) is now split into one ROW PER CONSTRUCT, matching Prolog's
# precedent (rung01/rung02/rung13/rung14/rung15/rung19/rung35 below) instead of comma-joining constructs
# into one CONSTRUCT cell as the pre-migration file did.
# ⛔ PAIRS is a LIGHT FIRST PASS (one plausible lower-rung construct per row), not graded by this row's
# own DONE-WHEN (--phase isolation only) -- refine or extend for the combinations row, don't treat as final.
# ⛔ GAPS FOUND, NOT YET MINTED (this session ran out of turn budget before the mint/classify step -- see
# this row's task LEDGER for why, and corpus_suite_harness.py's CSV feature-column shape for what minting
# correctly requires): rung12 string_relop_size is missing the string <<= (le) and >> (strict gt) forms --
# only << (slt) >>= (sge) == (seq) ~== (sne) and size (*) exist today, so the six-operator family the
# CONSTRUCT cell already promises is 4/6, not 6/6. Next actor: mint ladder__rung12_strrelop_size_sle and
# _sgt (oracle-cut, corrupted-ref-proven, following the exact style of the five siblings already in
# ALL.icn/ALL.ref/ALL.csv), THEN add sle|sgt to that row's FORMS below.
